variability.method: later epoch log-flux interpolated in wavelength at the earlier epoch's points (gap <= 1.5 bandwidths); dmag > 0 = fading; errors scaled by sqrt(chi2_red)
variability.note: control: Barnard's Star is not variable at the 0.1 mag level in the infrared, so these changes measure the systematics of saturated-star photometry

field_star_shifts.method: 15-sigma peaks in full-epoch co-adds (target track excluded), 2-D Gaussian centroids, matched within 1 px; median shift of each epoch relative to the last full epoch (grid is north-up)

criteria.name: D5/D6 proper motion total within 5% of catalog

criteria.threshold: shift within 20% and 10 deg of the predicted apparent shift, PA within 20 deg of north

criteria.name: saturated core masked in co-adds and flagged
